title: ComfyUI local video workstation
summary: A documented baseline for the local AI workstation and ComfyUI installation. Model and custom-node availability are tracked separately rather than assumed.

title: Product image-to-video
summary: Start from real product images, then evaluate camera movement, subject placement and product-shape consistency.

title: SeedVR2 video enhancement
summary: A SeedVR2 3B Int8 workflow template and related model filenames have been examined. Node installation, model loading and successful end-to-end execution remain separate validation items.

title: Product appearance consistency
summary: Check body shape, camera layout, buttons, logos, materials and colors shot by shot before judging stylistic quality.

title: Reproducible workflow records
summary: Record model dependencies, node versions, inputs, outputs, parameters, acceptance criteria and rollback steps for each reusable workflow.
